g.text: PR #2345 · Mobile Ready queue and reliable phone alerts
Mobile hid completed sessions; Ready now keeps unread replies within reach.
Receipts sync across devices; an open desktop no longer silences the phone.
BEFORE
AFTER
mobile-session-select
Session names and connection labels.
Only the selected mobile transcript is mounted.
No persistent cross-session unread queue.
session_attention + per-user receipts
Persist completed output for Claude and Codex.
Automatic or explicit receipts name a specific reply.
Refresh and delayed receipts cannot lose a new reply.
has_user_client(user_id)
Any live web client suppresses push delivery.
The desktop can remain connected all day.
The phone receives no alert, even for another session.
MobileReady + use_attention
Ready count, cycling Next, previews, mute and Mark read.
Approvals stay ready; switches and settings keep drafts.
Background transcripts stay unloaded.
Completed work is easy to miss
Manually inspect sessions on the phone.
A connected desktop makes silence ambiguous.
No test notification control in Settings.
push_suppressed + device setup
15-second same-conversation viewing lease.
Always-notify override and real transport test.
Android FCM tag replaces a session's previous alert.
Desktop presence was mistaken for user attention.
Android and iPhone share the same Ready interface.
Background push still needs device permission and configured delivery; physical-phone lock-screen delivery remains to be verified.
